description: Send invoice or expense lines as JSON; returns flags for duplicate IDs, repeat vendor+amount+date, missing fields and currency mismatch. Math only. Process-and-discard: nothing is stored or logged after the run. A request containing a Luhn-valid card number or a valid IBAN is refused before accept with reason sensitive_data_refused (not counted as a check). Free plan: runs under the shared free check cap. Desk: volume use.

api_key.description: Optional key (vdk_...). Same as the Bearer header.

expected_currency.description: The header currency all lines should use (e.g. GBP).

lines.description: Invoice or expense lines. Each line needs id, vendor, date, amount and currency.

options.description: Optional. round_number_note (bool, default true): informational note for amounts >= 1,000 that are exact multiples of 1,000.

name: check_invoice
title: Check invoice or expense lines
